identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase II Trial of Iparomlimab/Tuvonralimab (QL1706) + XELOX in HER2-Negative, Low PD-L1 G/GEJ Adenocarcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Safety and Efficacy of Iparomlimab and Tuvonralimab (QL1706) Combined With Chemotherapy for the Treatment of HER2-Negative, Low PD-L1 Expressing, Unresectable or Metastatic Gastric/Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma: A Phase II Single-Arm Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is single - arm study to explore the safety and efficacy of iparomlimab and tuvonralimab (QL1706) combined with chemotherapy for treating her2-negative, low PD-L1 expressing, unresectable or metastatic gastric/gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma

conditions: Unresectable or Metastatic Gastric/Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma

interventions.name: Iparomlimab and Tuvonralimab (QL1706)
interventions.description: 5 mg/kg, ivdrip, Day 1, Q3W, until progressive disease or intolerable toxicity.

interventions.name: Oxallplation
interventions.description: 130 mg/m2, ivdrip, Day 1, Q3W, for the first 6 cycles.

interventions.name: Capectitabine Tablets
interventions.description: 1000 mg/m2, po, bid, Days 1-14, Q3W, until progressive disease or intolerable toxicity.

primaryOutcomes.description: The time from the starting date of study drug to the date of first documentation of disease progression or death, whichever occurs first (per RECIST 1.1).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 12 months after the last subject participating in

secondaryOutcomes.description: The time from the starting date of study drug to the date of death due to any cause.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 12 months after the last subject participating in

secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of subjects with complete response (CR) and partial response (PR) according RESIST1.1 in total subjects.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 6 months after the last subject participating in

secondaryOutcomes.description: The time from the date for first documented response of complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) to the date of first documented of disease progression or death, whichever occurs first.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 12 months after the last subject participating in

secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of subjects with complete response (CR) and partial response (PR) and stable disease(SD) in total subjects
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 12 months after the last subject participating in
